### ClientRegistrationResponse

A successful client registration response, as defined by RFC 7591.

Required: `client_id_issued_at`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | string |  | Gets or sets the identifier assigned to the client. |

| `client_secret` | string |  | Gets or sets the secret issued to a confidential client. |
| `client_secret_expires_at` | int64 |  | Gets or sets when the secret expires, in seconds since the Unix epoch; zero means never. |
| `client_name` | string |  | Gets or sets the name recorded for the client. |
| `redirect_uris` | string[] |  | Gets or sets the registered redirect URIs. |
| `grant_types` | string[] |  | Gets or sets the grant types the client may use. |
| `response_types` | string[] |  | Gets or sets the response types the client may use. |
